author: s. j. fletcher
title: Miami Dolphins announce signing of long snapper Taybor Pepper
text:
The Miami Dolphins announced on Mar. 19 that they have signed long snapper Taybor Pepper.
The addition of Pepper brings experience to the Dolphins’ special teams unit, as he has played in 100 career games over seven seasons with Green Bay, Miami, and San Francisco. The team said that Pepper has also participated in nine postseason games with San Francisco.
Pepper began his National Football League career after signing a reserve/futures contract with Green Bay in 2017. He previously played college football at Michigan State from 2012 to 2015, where he was a four-year letterman and appeared in 54 games.
The Dolphins did not disclose further details about the terms of the signing or how Pepper will fit into their roster for the upcoming season.
